Given path '/api/v1/users/me/password' 0.000

And request { currentPassword: '#(collabPassword)', newPassword: 'NewPassword123!' } 0.000

* match response.success == true 0.000

Scenario PAWK-172 - Un manager n'a accès qu'à la liste des collaborateurs
Steps
# When: le manager appelle l'endpoint de recherche d'utilisateurs
Given path '/api/v1/users' 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + managerToken 0.000
And param page = 0 0.000
And param size = 100 0.000
When method get 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.success == true 0.000
# Then: seuls les collaborateurs sont retournés
* def users = response.data.content 0.000
* assert users.length > 0 0.000
# And: il ne doit pas y avoir d'administrateurs
* def hasAdmin = users.some(function(u) { return u.roleType === 'ADMINISTRATOR'; }) 0.000
* assert hasAdmin == false 0.000
# And: il ne doit pas y avoir de managers
* def hasManager = users.some(function(u) { return u.roleType === 'MANAGER'; }) 0.000
* assert hasManager == false 0.000
# And: tous les utilisateurs retournés sont des collaborateurs
* def allCollaborators = users.every(function(u) { return u.roleType === 'COLLABORATOR'; }) 0.000
* assert allCollaborators == true 0.000

Scenario PAWK-411 - Soumission valide d'un congé payé et apparition dans my-requests
Steps

And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
And request { type: 'PAID_LEAVE', startDate: '#(futureStart)', endDate: '#(futureEnd)' } 0.000
When method post 0.000
Then status 201 0.000
And match response.status == 'PENDING' 0.000
And match response.type == 'PAID_LEAVE' 0.000
And match response.id == '#number' 0.000
And match response.userId == '#number' 0.000
* def leaveId = response.id 0.000
Given path '/api/v1/leaves/my-requests' 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
When method get 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
And match response.content == '#[] #object' 0.000
And match response.content[*].id contains leaveId 0.000
# Cleanup
Given path '/api/v1/leaves/' + leaveId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
When method delete 0.000
